replies.author: @cancelledKate
replies.text:
I heard a preacher(I am agnostic) once say that leaving the building, doesn't mean the congregation,  or the church, is gone...it is the PEOPLE, who are the church!  
Same goes for money, as in a company's worth...the company can change location, it doesn't mean their policies, or their wealth changes...just look at all of the production companies (of both commodities, and Hollywood movies😂)moving from expensive places, with poor leadership, to less expensive places, with more intelligent leaders.  Policies stay the same,  prices go down, strictures are loosened, all, are happy.  

Except for the place that sunk!

comments.text: In 2024, the families of Gardi Sugdub became one of the first communities in Latin America to leave their island because of rising seas 🌊 Hundreds of people moved to the mainland, and some still go back by boat. Would you leave your home island, or fight to stay? 🤔
